<thought>To obtain a one‑step retrosynthesis, I will look for a retrosynthetic template that breaks the alkene bond present in the target molecule. This corresponds to a forward reaction that forms an alkene, so I will search the template catalog for templates where an alkene is broken in the retrosynthetic direction.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>

  "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["alkene"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
